b2-argentinaregiones-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Look of the Pampa
b2-argentinaregiones-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the pampas, and he asks what the landscape is like.
b2-argentinaregiones-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what the pampa looks like and what it really has.
cues: Say what it has in spite of that
b2-argentinaregiones-01.target: Si bien la pampa parece plana, tiene paisajes muy variados.
b2-argentinaregiones-01.english: Although the pampa looks flat, it has very varied landscapes.
b2-argentinaregiones-01.canDo: I can grant a true point formally with *si bien* (*si bien la pampa parece plana, tiene paisajes variados*).

b2-argentinaregiones-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Grape of Mendoza
b2-argentinaregiones-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading an article about the wines of Mendoza, and she asks about the Malbec grape.
b2-argentinaregiones-02.prompt: Tell Meg what happened to the Malbec grape over time.
b2-argentinaregiones-02.target: Con el tiempo, el malbec llegó a convertirse en la uva más conocida del país.
b2-argentinaregiones-02.english: In time, Malbec became the best-known grape of the country.
b2-argentinaregiones-02.canDo: I can say that something reaches a point or an extreme with *llegar a* + infinitive (*llegó a convertirse*, *si llega a faltar*).

b2-argentinaregiones-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Dry Valley
b2-argentinaregiones-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the Quebrada de Humahuaca, and he asks if people can live there.
b2-argentinaregiones-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that the valley is dry but people live there.
cues: Say that the valley is dry
Contrast it with a fact about the communities
b2-argentinaregiones-03.target: La quebrada es muy seca; sin embargo, allí viven muchas comunidades.
b2-argentinaregiones-03.english: The ravine is very dry; however, many communities live there.
b2-argentinaregiones-03.canDo: I can set one fact against another with *sin embargo* and *no obstante* (*la quebrada es seca; sin embargo, allí viven comunidades*).

b2-argentinaregiones-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Welsh Settlers
b2-argentinaregiones-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading an article about Patagonia, and she asks why the Welsh settlers did not leave.
b2-argentinaregiones-04.prompt: Tell Meg that the settlers stayed despite the climate.
b2-argentinaregiones-04.target: A pesar de las dificultades del clima, los colonos galeses se quedaron.
b2-argentinaregiones-04.english: Despite the difficulties of the climate, the Welsh settlers stayed.
b2-argentinaregiones-04.canDo: I can say that something happened despite a difficulty with *a pesar de*, *a pesar de que* and *pese a*.

b2-argentinaregiones-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Train at the End of the World
b2-argentinaregiones-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are planning a trip to Ushuaia after a documentary, and he asks about the old train.
b2-argentinaregiones-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what became of the old train.
cues: Show that it took a long process
b2-argentinaregiones-05.target: El viejo tren terminó por convertirse en una atracción turística.
b2-argentinaregiones-05.english: The old train ended up as a tourist attraction.
b2-argentinaregiones-05.canDo: I can say how a process ended with *terminar por* and *acabar por* + infinitive (*el tren terminó por convertirse en una atracción turística*).

b2-argentinaregiones-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From the Pampas to the South
b2-argentinaregiones-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have watched a whole documentary about Argentina, and she asks what surprised you.
b2-argentinaregiones-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg one thing that surprised you, with a formal contrast.
b2-argentinaregiones-consolidation.target: Si bien la pampa parece plana, tiene paisajes muy variados.
b2-argentinaregiones-consolidation.english: Although the pampa looks flat, it has very varied landscapes.
b2-argentinaregiones-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about the regions of Argentina, from the pampas to Tierra del Fuego.
